semantic_loss_findings.finding: Dropping producer IDs and exact reference closure while retaining prose forces illicit rematching and destroys proof of which exact upstream authority grounded a downstream object.
Dropping typed denial, valid-empty, noncomparability, uncertainty, measured-zero, or missing-authority state manufactures semantics if replaced by zero/neutral/readiness defaults.
Dropping V551/V551J/V552J evidentiary and admission lineage raises the cost or impossibility of adjudicating why a structural fact was lawfully admitted even when runtime does not see the packet.
Dropping duplicate prose, plots, status summaries, or reversible aggregate projections while preserving canonical machine truth mainly loses audit convenience rather than causal capability.
Replacing canonical producer IDs with downstream aliases or slot/status flattening can preserve superficial values while destroying producer ownership, graph participant identity, and replayability.

If the named V550 determinicity summaries disappear while governed conditional response/position authority plus provenance survives, no terminal execution capability was demonstrated here as lost; forensic visibility into heterogeneity/outliers may become costlier.
